cases.name: source receipt from tenant A cannot authorize objective in tenant B
CloudEvents source plus id deduplicates within source without cross-source collisions
same key and same request replays the original operation once
same key with changed request is a conflict and cannot add an effect
current tenant permission revocation after grant issuance blocks commit
sink rejects stale worker after a replacement epoch is installed
grant cannot be rebound to an attacker-controlled resource

limitations: Pure in-memory reference model; no cryptographic issuer validation, persistent policy store or production sink is exercised.
Tenant identity and event provenance are trusted model inputs; signatures and key revocation remain unimplemented.
This does not qualify cross-tenant isolation in a real database or service mesh.
